feature: TorchFLIRT input, output-grid, and FSL scaled-mm matrix contract

reference.reason: UKB fsl_reg uses applywarp for the final affine-plus-nonlinear resampling

contract.reference: fixed/reference image defining output shape and geometry
contract.output: float32 image on the reference grid
contract.matrix: 4x4 ASCII moving/input-to-fixed/reference transform in FSL scaled-mm

same_emitted_matrix_coordinate_ramps.evaluation: source coordinates at fixed voxels whose three coordinates are at least one voxel inside the moving field of view

fsl_flirt_applyxfm_boundary.note: FSL flirt -applyxfm and FSL applywarp use different final resampling behavior when reducing voxel resolution. The package output follows the applywarp trilinear sampling used by fsl_reg; it does not claim voxelwise parity with every flirt -applyxfm interpolation mode.

interpretation: The tested matrix direction, scaled-mm handedness conversion, reference-grid header, and applywarp sampling coordinates agree. TorchFLIRT uses an independent NCC and Adam optimizer, so its estimated matrix and FSL FLIRT's estimated matrix are not expected to be numerically equal.
privacy: Aggregate-only; source paths, subject identifiers, matrices, and point coordinates are excluded.
